format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and CSS
description: A complete HTML webpage implementing the UI for a database visualization tool, including styles, layout, and client-side JavaScript logic for fetching and displaying database and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database item to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data into HTML, handling wide contents and formatting.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, including expandable objects and long text handling.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
